name: Manastorm: a disconnected duo member's stale run registration expires after the resume window (#8341)
contract: #8341: a player grouped with a duo partner who had disconnected mid-run got ENTER_MANASTORM_BAD_GROUP_SIZE
from ValidateEnter() (ManastormClientBridge.cpp) because the disconnected partner stayed registered in
ManastormMgr's _memberRunIds. OnPlayerLogout (Manastorm.cpp) never called StopRun/FailRun for the logging
-out member, and the private instance's own empty-map unload timer never starts while another member
(here, the one who stays online) keeps the stage non-empty, so nothing else ever cleaned up the stale
membership either; docs/coa/manastorm.md promises a short disconnect only blocks resume 'for up to 120
seconds', not indefinitely.
The fix adds ManastormMgr::OnPlayerLogout, which starts a 120000ms grace timer for the logging-out
member's run id, canceled by ManastormMgr::OnPlayerLogin if they come back, and otherwise consumed by
ManastormMgr::Update to FailRun the run once it expires and the member is still mapped to that same run.
This scenario starts a real duo run (both members physically transferred into the private stage) from a
known fixed position, then disconnects one member through the harness's native WorldSession::LogoutPlayer
while the other stays inside the stage (so the stage never becomes empty and the engine's own idle-unload
timer, which this fix's grace timer is independent of, never starts). It asserts that once the documented
120-second resume window elapses, the remaining member's run is failed and they land back at that saved
pre-run position (ManastormFailureExit::SavedLocation, the same exit the pre-existing 'stage no longer
available for reconnect' and 'private stage instance has expired' paths already use for an abandoned
run, as opposed to FactionHub, which only the death/wipe release path uses), proving the stale
registration no longer survives indefinitely. Before the fix nothing ever ends the run here, so the
remaining member would stay in the private instance forever.
